spec.description: Matched route template. Duende endpoints such as /connect/token and /connect/authorize run as middleware without a route and are grouped as (unrouted) together with static files and unmatched paths. Docker health probes are excluded.
spec.title: Requests per second by route

spec.description: Share of all HTTP responses with a 4xx or 5xx status, health probes excluded. 4xx is mostly client errors such as rejected registrations and failed logins; 5xx is server faults.
spec.title: Error rate

spec.description: Server-side request duration from the ASP.NET Core histogram. See the requests panel for what (unrouted) means. Docker health probes are excluded.
spec.title: p95 latency by route

spec.expr: (sum(last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

spec.description: All HTTP requests in the selected time range, health probes excluded. Exact counter difference per series, so restarts and the first request on a route are counted.
spec.title: Requests (range)

spec.expr: (sum(last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health", http_response_status_code=~"4.."} offset $__range) or vector(0))

spec.description: Client error responses in the selected time range, health probes excluded. Mostly rejected registrations, bad logins and failed token requests.
spec.title: 4xx responses (range)

spec.expr: (sum(last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!="/health", http_response_status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range) or vector(0))
